firstPlayerRule: Choose the multiplayer starting player randomly and give them the Follower bag.
clarifications: The bag holder draws the round’s Followers, then chooses the first Follower and takes its action. Choices continue clockwise.
The extra Followers give the starter three actions in a two-player round, or two actions with three to five players. The other players each get two or one, respectively.
After the round’s actions are finished, pass the bag clockwise for the next round. Refill an empty bag as instructed before passing it; the final emptying ends the game instead.
In solo play, the human starts and Joan takes the second turn.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 2, 8, 9, 12. Rendered page 1 assigns the bag randomly. Page 2 begins clockwise choices with its holder, distinguishes two-player and three-to-five-player extra actions, and rotates the bag after resolving/refilling the round. Page 8 explicitly says the human begins and Joan goes second in solo; page 9 clarifies the automated opponent's actions. Page 12 credits are ©2022, while the publisher's linked file is dated January 24, 2023. These dates are kept distinct. This draw-and-write game is not the original Orléans.
